cumulativeSmallPageBudgetRegression.before: the page budget counted only the sum of frame bodies, so the assembled response (producer envelope plus wrapper) overran the transport cap and surfaced as unknown_outcome for legal records; the independent 10/11 run saw 160 valid records fail
cumulativeSmallPageBudgetRegression.after: the WHOLE ENCODED PAGE is budgeted. A page that would overrun is trimmed from the tail and reported with done=false and a real cursor, so the caller continues instead of losing the replay. A page that cannot fit even one frame is refused explicitly as page_exceeds_cap rather than as a generic 500
cumulativeSmallPageBudgetRegression.whyNotJustRaiseTheCap: the transport cap is unchanged at 64KiB; the fix is correct accounting plus trim-and-continue, not a wider cap
